title: Compressed Recurrent Feedback in Tsetlin Machines: A Reproducible Boolean-FSM Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.06133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequential inference on small devices requires a model to retain useful history without repeatedly processing a long input record. A Recurrent Tsetlin Machine (RTM) provides this memory by returning Boolean clause outputs from one time step as inputs to the next. Direct feedback, however, grows with the clause bank and can make the recurrent input unnecessarily wide. This paper investigates a fixed-width alternative. We combine clause activations by exclusive-OR (XOR) folding, retain the folded bits at two time scales, and threshold them back to a binary state. The resulting design reduces 480 clause activations to 96 recurrent bits. We evaluate the method on a reproducible Boolean finite-state-machine benchmark with explicit transition rules, data splits, and random seeds. translated_title: Tsetlin机中的压缩循环反馈：一项可复现的布尔有限状态机研究
translated_abstract: 小型设备上的序列推理要求模型能够保留有用的历史信息，而无需反复处理冗长的输入记录。循环Tsetlin机（RTM）通过将一个时间步的布尔子句输出作为下一个时间步的输入来提供这种记忆能力。然而，直接反馈会随着子句库的规模而增长，可能使循环输入变得不必要地宽。本文研究了一种固定宽度的替代方案。我们通过异或（XOR）折叠来组合子句激活，在两个时间尺度上保留折叠后的比特，并将其阈值化回二进制状态。所得设计将480个子句激活压缩为96个循环比特。我们在一个可复现的布尔有限状态机基准上评估了该方法，该基准具有明确的转换规则、数据划分方式和随机种子。在144次运行中，压缩模型在两个任务族上分别取得了61.47±6.74%和62.94±9.92%的准确率。原始子句反馈使这些均值产生了……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种固定宽度的循环反馈压缩方法，通过XOR折叠与双时间尺度阈值化将循环Tsetlin机的480个子句激活压缩为96个比特，并在可复现的布尔有限状态机基准上验证了其准确率与原始反馈相当。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fixed-width recurrent feedback compression scheme for Tsetlin Machines, reducing 480 clause activations to 96 bits via XOR folding and two-timescale thresholding, with accuracy comparable to raw feedback on a reproducible Boolean finite-state-machine benchmark.
